Their collaboration showed repetitive insights with little progression, indicating a need for deeper analysis. The use of images was minimal and did not significantly enhance the textual analysis. The analysis highlighted salary disparities across countries, with hypotheses about role distribution affecting salary levels.

Germany and Belgium may have lower salaries due to different role distributions.
collaborationPatterns: Limited use of images to enhance textual analysis.
